a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.title: Me Pēhea te Hurihuri i te HEIC ki te JPG i te Waea me te Rorohiko (Kore Utu, Kāore He Taupānga)
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.excerpt: Kāore e taea te whakatuwhera i ngā whakaahua HEIC a te iPhone i runga i a Windows, Android rānei? Huria te HEIC ki te JPG i roto i ngā hēkona, kore utu, kāore hoki e tukuna ō whakaahua ki tētahi tūmau.
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.cap0: E tango whakaahua ana me te kāmera waea atamai.
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.cap1: E whakahaere whakaahua ana i runga i te rorohiko pōkai.
a.cara-convert-heic-ke-jpg.body:
Ka rongoā te iPhone i ngā whakaahua ki te hōputu HEIC nā te mea he iti ake te rahi i te JPG, he orite tonu te kounga. Ko te raru, he maha ngā pūrere me ngā taupānga, ina koa a Windows tawhito, Android, me ngā pae tukutuku, kāore anō kia taea te whakatuwhera i te HEIC. Ko te rongoā tino āhuareka ko te huri i te HEIC ki te JPG.

Mā I Need Convert e taea ai e koe te mahi i tērā i roto tonu i tō pūkaha tukutuku. Kāore ō whakaahua e tukuna ki tētahi tūmau, nō reira ka noho muna tonu.

He Aha te HEIC?

Ko te HEIC (High Efficiency Image Container) he hōputu whakaahua hou kua whakamahia e Apple mai i te iOS 11. Ka taea e tēnei hōputu te rongoā i ngā whakaahua ki te haurua noa iho o te rahi o te JPG, ka tautoko i ngā whakaahua Live, me te hōhonu tae teitei ake. Heoi, kāore anō kia whānui tōna tautoko.

Me Pēhea te Hurihuri i te HEIC ki te JPG

  1. Whakatuwhera i a ineedconvert.com i te pūkaha tukutuku o tō waea, rorohiko pōkai rānei.
  2. Pēhia te Tīpako Kōnae, ka tīpako i tētahi, i ētahi whakaahua HEIC rānei i te wā kotahi.
  3. Mō ia kōnae, tīpakohia te hōputu JPG i te rārangi taka iho.
  4. Pēhia te Huri te Huri katoa rānei.
  5. Ka tangohia aunoatia ngā whakaahua JPG ki tō pūrere.

Tohutohu: E hiahia ana koe i tētahi tāhuhu mārama? Tīpakohia te PNG. E hiahia ana koe i te kōnae iti rawa hei tuku mā te kōrero? Tīpakohia te WEBP.

Kia Rongoā Tonu te iPhone i te JPG

Mēnā e hiahia ana koe kia tango whakaahua tonu te iPhone ki te JPG, whakatuwhera i te Tautuhinga → Kāmera → Hōputu, ka tīpako i te Most Compatible. Ka rongoā ngā whakaahua e whai ake nei hei JPG, engari he iti te rahi ake.

Ngā Pātai Auau

Ka heke ake rānei te kounga o te whakaahua?

He tino iti te rerekētanga, kāore e kitea. Ka rongoāhia te JPG ki te kounga 92%, he teitei rawa mō te taarua, mō te tuku ki ngā pae pāpori hoki.

Ka taea te huri i ngā whakaahua maha i te wā kotahi?

Āe. Tīpakohia, toia rānei ngā whakaahua katoa ki te pouaka hurihuri, ka pēhi i te Huri katoa.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.title: Me Pēhea te Huri i te Ataata hei MP3 Kāore He Taupānga
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.excerpt: Tangohia te oro i ngā ataata MP4, MOV, MKV rānei, ka rongoā hei MP3 kounga 192 kbps. Kore utu, tere, i roto tonu i te pūkaha tukutuku.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.cap0: E whakarongo puoro ana me ngā taringa pūoro.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.cap1: He hopuoro mō te hopu oro.
a.cara-ubah-video-jadi-mp3.body:
I ētahi wā ko te oro anake te mea e hiahiatia ana e koe: he hopunga kauhau, he pōkai ataata, he whakangungu puoro, he hopunga hui rānei. Tēnā i te tāuta i tētahi taupānga anō, ka taea e koe te huri i te ataata hei MP3 i roto tonu i a I Need Convert.

Ngā Tāwhaitanga

  1. Whakatuwhera i te whārangi hurihuri, ka pēhi i te Tīpako Kōnae.
  2. Tīpakohia te ataata (MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, AVI, me ētahi atu).
  3. I te rārangi taka iho hōputu, tīpakohia te MP3.
  4. Pēhia te Huri ka tatari kia oti te pae anga.
  5. Ka rongoāhia tonutia te kōnae MP3 ki te kōpaki Tangohanga.

I te wā tuatahi e huri ai koe i te ataata, i te oro rānei, me uta e te pūkaha tukutuku te pūkaha hurihuri, tata ki te 30 MB. I muri i tērā, he tere ake ngā hurihuri e whai ake nei.

Tīpakohia te Hōputu Oro Tika

  • MP3: te tino hototahi, ka taea te purei i runga i tētahi pūrere.
  • M4A / AAC: he iti te rahi me te kounga pai, hāngai mō te iPhone. Mai i te ataata MP4, ka taea te kape i te oro kāore he whakawaehere anō, nō reira tata tonu.
  • WAV / FLAC: kāore he whakahāinga e whakapōrearea ana i te kounga, tika mō te whakatika.
  • OPUS / OGG: tino whai hua mō te oro kōrero.

Tohutohu: Mō ngā hopunga oro ka whakatikahia anō, rongoāhia tuatahi hei WAV, ka huri ki te MP3 ina oti te whakatika.

Whakamahia Mā te Whakaaro

Me mātua mōhio he mana tō koe ki te ataata e huria ana. Mō ngā ihirangi a ētahi atu, whakamahia mō ō hiahia whaiaro anake, me te whakaute i ngā mana pupuri a te kaihanga.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.title: Me Pēhea te Hurihuri i te PDF ki te Word (DOCX) Kore Utu, Haumaru Hoki
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.excerpt: Huria te kuputuhi i roto i te PDF hei tuhinga Word ka taea te whakatika. Kāore he rēhita, kāore he tohu wai, kāore hoki e tukuna te kōnae ki tētahi tūmau.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.cap0: E patopato tuhinga ana i runga i te rorohiko pōkai.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.cap1: He pukapuka me tētahi pene i runga i te tēpu mahi.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-word.body:
He pai te PDF mō te pānui me te tohatoha, engari he uaua te whakatika. Mēnā me tango koe i ngā ihirangi o te PDF hei whakatika anō, ko te huarahi tere rawa ko te huri i te PDF ki te Word (DOCX).

Me Pēhea te Huri i te PDF ki te DOCX

  1. Whakatuwhera i a I Need Convert ka tīpako i te kōnae PDF.
  2. Tīpakohia te hōputu DOCX.
  3. Pēhia te Huri, ka whakatuwhera i te hua i roto i a Microsoft Word, Google Docs, WPS rānei.

Ka tangohia te kuputuhi o ia whārangi ka whakaritea anō hei rārangi kuputuhi ka taea te whakatika tonu.

Ngā Mea Me Mōhio

  • Ko ngā PDF kua matawai he whakaahua, ehara i te kuputuhi. Mō ēnei PDF, kāore e taea te tango i te kuputuhi me te kore OCR.
  • Kāore ngā whakatakotoranga uauatanga pērā i ngā tīwai takirua, ngā ripanga, me ngā whakaahua e haere tahi i ngā wā katoa. Ko te aronga o tēnei hurihuri ko te ihirangi kuputuhi.
  • Mēnā he kuputuhi mata anake te hiahia, tīpakohia te hōputu TXT.

Tohutohu: E hiahia ana koe kia mau tonu te āhua o te PDF pērā tonu i te taketake? Huria te PDF ki te PNG, JPG rānei, kotahi te whakaahua mō ia whārangi. Kei te tuhinga me pēhea te huri i te PDF hei whakaahua te aratohu.

He Aha i Haumaru Ake ai?

Ko ngā tuhinga pērā i ngā kirimana, ngā pākete utu, ngā kāri tuakiri hoki, kaua e tukuna ki ngā pae tukutuku noa iho. I I Need Convert, ka mahia ngā mahi katoa i runga i tō pūrere, nō reira kāore ō tuhinga e wehe i tō waea, i tō rorohiko pōkai rānei.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.title: Me Pēhea te Huri i te PDF hei Whakaahua JPG, PNG rānei
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.excerpt: Ka whakaahua mārama kotahi ia whārangi PDF. Tangohia takitahi, katoa rānei i te wā kotahi i roto i te kōnae ZIP kotahi.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.cap0: He kōpaki ki tonu i ngā kōnae tuhinga.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.cap1: E whakatuwhera tuhinga ana i runga i te rorohiko pōkai.
a.cara-convert-pdf-ke-jpg.body:
I ētahi wā he whakararu te tuku PDF mā te kōrero nā te mea me whakatuwhera e te kaiwhiwhi tētahi atu taupānga. Mā te huri i te PDF hei whakaahua, ka taea te tiro tonu i ngā ihirangi, te tohatoha ki ngā tūnga, te whakapiri rānei ki tētahi whakaaturanga.

Ngā Tāwhaitanga

  1. Whakatuwhera i a I Need Convert ka tīpako i te kōnae PDF.
  2. Tīpakohia te hōputu JPG, PNG, WEBP rānei.
  3. Pēhia te Huri.
  4. Tangohia ia whārangi, pēhia rānei te Tango katoa hei rongoā i ngā whārangi katoa i roto i te ZIP kotahi.

Ka whakaahuatia ngā whārangi ki te whakatau rua taimaha, nō reira ka mārama tonu te kuputuhi ina whakarahia.

JPG, PNG, WEBP rānei?

  • JPG: he iti te rahi, hāngai mō ngā tuhinga whakaahua, mō te tuku mā te kōrero rānei.
  • PNG: te mārama rawa mō te kuputuhi me ngā hoahoa, he nui ake te rahi.
  • WEBP: te tino whakaaetanga pai i waenga i te mārama me te rahi.

E raru tonu ana? Pānuitia te rerekētanga o te JPG, PNG, me te WEBP.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.title: Te Rerekētanga o te JPG, PNG, me te WEBP: Tīpakohia te Hōputu Whakaahua Tika
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.excerpt: Āhea te JPG, āhea te PNG, āhea te WEBP? Mōhiotia ngā painga me ngā ngoikoretanga o ia tahi kia mārama, kia māmā hoki ō whakaahua.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.cap0: He kaiāwhata whakaahua me tana kāmera.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.cap1: He kaihoahoa whakaahua e mahi ana i mua i te rorohiko.
a.perbedaan-jpg-png-webp.body:
Mā te hōputu whakaahua tika e iti haere ai te kōnae me te kore e kitea he rerekētanga. Anei te rerekētanga o ngā hōputu e toru e tino whakamahia ana.

JPG

Ka whakamahi te JPG i te whakawhāiti lossy, arā ka tahuri atu ētahi taipitopito kia iti ai te kōnae. He tino pai mō ngā whakaahua, engari he kore pai mō te kuputuhi, ngā tohu, ngā hopukanga mata rānei nā te mea ka ahua kōpā ngā taha. Kāore te JPG e tautoko i te tāhuhu mārama.

PNG

Ka whakamahi te PNG i te whakawhāiti lossless, nō reira kāore he taipitopito e ngaro. Ko te kōwhiringa pai rawa mō ngā hopukanga mata, ngā tohu, ngā ikoni, me ngā whakaahua whai tāhuhu mārama. Ko te ngoikoretanga, ka tino nui te kōnae mēnā he whakaahua taarua kei te PNG.

WEBP

Ko te WEBP he hōputu hou nā Google e tautoko ana i te whakawhāiti lossy me lossless, me te mārama hoki. I te nuinga o te wā he 25–35% iti ake i te JPG, he orite te kounga. Hāngai mō ngā pae tukutuku me te tuku mā te kōrero.

Whakarāpopototanga

  • Ngā whakaahua mō te taarua, mō te tuku rānei: JPG.
  • Ngā tohu, ngā ikoni, ngā hopukanga mata: PNG.
  • Ngā whakaahua mō te pae tukutuku: WEBP.
  • Ikoni pae tukutuku (favicon): ICO.

Tohutohu: Ka taea e ngā hōputu katoa i runga ake nei te huri ki a rātou anō i I Need Convert, tae atu ki te HEIC, BMP, TIFF, me te SVG.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.title: Me Pēhea te Hurihuri i te MOV ki te MP4 Me te Kore e Heke te Kounga
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.excerpt: Kāore e taea te purei i ngā ataata MOV a te iPhone, a te kāmera rānei i runga i ngā pūrere katoa? Huria ki te MP4 i roto i ngā hēkona me te kore whakawaehere anō.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.cap0: He kaiataata e hopu ataata ana.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.cap1: He kāmera waea atamai me tētahi kāmera matihiko.
a.cara-convert-mov-ke-mp4.body:
Ko te MOV te hōputu ataata taunoa a te iPhone me te maha o ngā kāmera. Heoi, kāore ētahi taupānga, pouaka whakaata, pae tukutuku hoki e tautoko ana. Ko te MP4 te hōputu haumaru rawa nā te mea ka taea te purei i ngā wāhi katoa tata.

Me Pēhea te Huri i te MOV ki te MP4

  1. Whakatuwhera i a I Need Convert ka tīpako i te ataata MOV.
  2. Tīpakohia te hōputu MP4.
  3. Pēhia te Huri, ka tatari kia oti.

He Aha i Tere Rawa ai?

Ko te MOV me te MP4 he "ipu" noa iho. Ko ō roto, arā te ataata H.264/HEVC me te oro AAC, he orite tonu i te nuinga o te wā. Ka whakamātau tuatahi a I Need Convert ki te neke i te rere ataata ki tētahi ipu hou me te kore whakawaehere anō. Tata tonu te hua, 100% hoki te orite o te kounga ki te taketake.

Mēnā kāore ngā ihirangi o te ataata e hāngai ki te ipu e whāia ana, ka whakawaeheretia anōtia aunoatia ki te H.264 kia taea tonu te purei.

Tohutohu: He orite tonu te tikanga mō te MKV ki te MP4, te MP4 ki te MOV, me te TS ki te MP4.

Ētahi Atu Hōputu Ataata

  • WEBM: hāngai mō ngā pae tukutuku.
  • MKV: ka tautoko i te maha o ngā kupu āpiti me ngā whaiaro oro.
  • GIF: mō ngā hākoritanga poto kāore he oro. Tirohia me pēhea te hanga GIF mai i te ataata.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.title: Me Pēhea te Hurihuri i te Excel (XLSX) ki te CSV, JSON, me te Whakamuri
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.excerpt: Huria te kōnae Excel ki te CSV hei kawe ki tētahi atu taupānga, te CSV ki te XLSX rānei kia ātaahua te tuwhera i Excel. Ka huri ngā whārangi katoa.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.cap0: He hoahoa me ngā raraunga i runga i te tēpu mahi.
a.cara-convert-excel-ke-csv.body:
He maha ngā taupānga, mai i ngā toa ipurangi tae atu ki ngā rorohiko kaute, e tono ana i ngā raraunga ki te hōputu CSV. Ki te taha kē, he māmā ake te whakahaere i ngā kōnae CSV ina huria ki te XLSX. Ka taea e koe ngā mea e rua i I Need Convert.

Excel ki te CSV

  1. Tīpakohia te kōnae XLSX, XLS, ODS rānei.
  2. Tīpakohia te hōputu CSV.
  3. Pēhia te Huri. Mēnā he maha ngā whārangi o te kōnae, ka waiho ia whārangi hei kōnae CSV kotahi, ā, ka taea te tango katoa hei ZIP.

Ka rongoāhia te CSV ki te UTF-8 BOM, nō reira ka tika tonu te whakaatu o ngā reta pērā i te é, ü rānei ina whakatuwheratia ki Excel.

CSV ki te Excel

Tīpakohia te kōnae CSV, TSV rānei, ka tīpako i te XLSX, XLS, ODS rānei.

Whārangi Tātaitai ki te JSON

Mō ngā kaiwhakawhanake, tīpakohia te hōputu JSON. Ka waiho ia rārangi hei ahanoa kotahi, me te ingoa tīwai hei kī. Ki te taha kē, ka taea hoki te huri i ngā kōnae JSON, YAML, XML rānei ki te CSV, ki te XLSX rānei.

Tohutohu: Kāore ngā tātai Excel e haere ki te CSV, ko ngā uara hua anake. Rongoā hoki i te kōnae XLSX taketake mēnā e hiahiatia ana ngā tātai.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.title: Me Pēhea te Hanga GIF mai i te Ataata Mā te Māmā
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.excerpt: Huria tētahi wāhanga ataata hei GIF hākori ka taea te purei auau. He māmā te rahi, he pai tonu te tae, i roto tonu i te pūkaha tukutuku.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.cap1: Te tohatoha ihirangi i ngā pae pāpori.
a.cara-membuat-gif-dari-video.body:
Ko te GIF tonu te huarahi tino māmā mō te tohatoha i ngā hākoritanga poto: he urupare whakakata, he tāwhaitanga ako, he whakaaturanga taupānga rānei. Ka taea e koe te hanga GIF mai i te ataata MP4, MOV, WEBM, me ētahi atu.

Ngā Tāwhaitanga

  1. Whakareri i tētahi ataata poto, tino pai mēnā kei raro iho i te 10 hēkona.
  2. Whakatuwhera i a I Need Convert ka tīpako i te ataata.
  3. Tīpakohia te hōputu GIF, ka pēhi i te Huri.

Ka hangaia te GIF ki te 12 anga i ia hēkona, te whānui nui rawa 480 pika, me tētahi pālete tae kua tātaihia mō tō ataata anake. Ka mārama tonu te hua me te rahi e tika ana.

Ngā Tohutohu Kia Māmā te GIF

  • Whakamahia he ataata poto. Ko te roa te mea tino pā ki te rahi kōnae.
  • Karohia ngā ataata he nui te nekehanga kāmera.
  • Mēnā he nui rawa tonu te GIF, whakaarohia te WEBM te MP4 rānei. Ka taea te 10 taima iti ake te rahi, ā, ka taea tonu te purei aunoa i runga i te maha o ngā tūāpapa.

GIF ki te Ataata

Ki te taha kē, ka taea hoki te huri i te GIF ki te MP4 te WEBM rānei. Hāngai mō te tuku ki ngā tūāpapa kāore e whakaae ana ki te GIF.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.title: He Haumaru te Hurihuri Kōnae Ipurangi? Anei Ngā Mea Me Mōhio Koe
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.excerp: He maha ngā kaihurihuri ipurangi e tuku ana i ō kōnae ki a rātou tūmau. Mōhiotia ngā tūraru me te huarahi haumaru hei huri i ngā tuhinga whakahirahira.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.cap0: He raka hei tohu mō te haumarutanga raraunga.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.cap1: E mahi ana me te rorohiko pōkai.
a.apakah-convert-file-online-aman.body:
He āhuareka ngā kaihurihuri ipurangi, engari ko te nuinga e mahi ana mā te tuku i te kōnae ki tētahi tūmau, ka tukatuka i reira, ka whakahoki mai i te hua. Mō ngā whakaahua hararei pea kāore he raru, engari me pēhea mō te kāri tuakiri, te kirimana mahi, ngā raraunga kiritaki rānei?

Ngā Tūraru o te Tuku Kōnae

  • Ka taea te rongoā i te kōnae ki te tūmau mō te roa atu i te mea i oati ai.
  • Ka taea te kōkuhu i te tūmau, ā, ka rere noa te kōnae.
  • Kāore koe e mōhio ko wai kei a ia te whai wāhi ki taua kōnae.
  • Ko te tuku me te tango i ngā kōnae nui ka pau te pūranga raraunga me te wā.

He Pēhea te Rerekē o I Need Convert?

Ka whakahaere a I Need Convert i ngā hurihuri katoa i roto i tō pūkaha tukutuku. Ka pānuitia, ka tukatukahia te kōnae e tō ake pūrere, ka rongoāhia tonutia te hua ki te kōpaki Tangohanga. Kāore he kōnae e tukuna ki ā mātou tūmau.

He painga anō: nā te kore o te tukunga, ka oti i roto i ngā hēkona te hurihuri whakaahua me tuhinga.

Ngā Tohutohu Haumaru mō te Hurihuri Tuhinga

  • Whakamahia he kaihurihuri e tukatuka ana i ngā kōnae ā-rohe mō ngā tuhinga tairongo.
  • Mukua ngā kōnae hua i te kōpaki Tangohanga ina kāore e hiahiatia ana.
  • Karohia te huri i ngā tuhinga hira i runga i ngā rorohiko tūmatanui.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.t: Kāore e Taea te Whakatuwhera te Kōnae Kua Huri? Ngā Take me ngā Rongoā
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.e: Kāore te hua hurihuri e whakatuwhera, e purei rānei? Anei ngā take tino auau me te huarahi e whakatika ai.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.c: E rangirua ana nā te mea kāore e taea te whakatuwhera te kōnae.
a.file-hasil-convert-tidak-bisa-dibuka.b:
I ētahi wā, kāore e taea te whakatuwhera i te kōnae kua huri i roto i tētahi taupānga. I te nuinga o te wā, ehara te take i te kōnae pakaru, engari i te taupānga kāore anō kia tautoko i taua hōputu. Anei ētahi take tino auau.

1. Kāore te Taupānga i Tautoko i te Hōputu

Ko ngā hōputu pērā i te WEBP, AVIF, OPUS, MKV rānei, kāore anō kia tautokotia e ngā taupānga tawhito katoa. Ko te rongoā, tīpakohia he hōputu noa ake: JPG mō ngā whakaahua, MP3 mō te oro, me te MP4 mō te ataata.

2. Ataata Kua Huri Me te Kore Whakawaehere Anō

Ina huri koe i te ipu ataata, pēnei i te MKV ki te MP4, ka kapehia te rere ataata pēnei tonu. Mēnā he codec HEVC (H.265) tō te ataata taketake, kāore ētahi pūrere tawhito e taea te purei. Whakamātauria te huri ki te WEBM ki te AVI rānei ka whakawaeheretia anōtia i ngā wā katoa, me te purei rānei mā te VLC.

3. Kāore anō te Kōnae kia Oti te Tango

Mō ngā kōnae nui, tatari kia oti rawa te tangohanga i te pūkaha tukutuku i mua i te whakatuwhera.

4. He Kuputuhi PDF Kau Ina Huri ki te DOCX ki te TXT rānei

Te āhua nei he PDF kua matawai, nō reira he whakaahua ōna ihirangi. Huria ki te JPG ki te PNG rānei hei rongoā i ngā ihirangi.

5. He Reta Rerekē i te CSV

Me mātua whakatuwhera i te CSV me te whakawaehere UTF-8. Kua whai tohu UTF-8 ngā kōnae CSV mai i I Need Convert kia pai ai te pānui a Excel.

Kei te raru tonu? Pānuitia hoki te rerekētanga o te JPG, PNG, me te WEBP hei tīpako i te hōputu tino hāngai.
